DNS::ptype
Description
This iRules command returns the type of the DNS packet.
Note
: This command requires the DNS Profile, which is only enabled
as part of GTM or the DNS Services add-on.
Syntax
DNS
::
ptype
DNS::ptype
returns the type of the DNS packet. Return values:
QUESTION
REFERRAL
ANSWER
NXDOMAIN
NODATA
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
DNS_REQUEST
,
DNS_RESPONSE
,
GLOBAL_GTM
